dedupe_keys.name: montreal road assets database aggregate roadway and intersection

description: The Road Assets Database of the City of Montréal, published as "Aggregate roadway and intersection" through the Québec government and municipal open data portal and mirrored on Canada's Open Government Portal, describes the city's street assets. It covers roadways, blocks, intersections, sidewalks and curbs, with attributes such as construction, resurfacing and survey dates, materials, foundation type and the presence of bike lanes. Coverage is one city, the territory of Montréal. The data are free under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (Québec) licence and available to download as CSV, GeoJSON and zipped shapefiles; the record was modified in September 2026. Caveats: it covers only the territory of the City of Montréal and the assets listed in the database. The ages, materials and resurfacing history suit condition and ageing, maintenance planning and flood or heat exposure studies at street level. It complements the National Road Network (NRN) for Canada and is related to other city asset inventories in the catalogue.
